name: Abertay University
description:
The university of Abertay is located in the stunning Scottish city of Dundee. 

Named University of the Year for Teaching Quality by The Times' Good University Guide 2021, the university has a strong reputation for its teaching quality.

Known for its specialist courses in computing and engineering, Abertay was the first university in the world to offer a computer games degree and the first in the world to offer a degree in Ethical Hacking.

It's campus is located in the centre of the city in a combination of historic and modern buildings.

What is the University of Abertay acceptance rate for International Students?

The University of Abertay acceptance rate is 85%.

Student Life

The University of Abertay has a city centre campus. The main buildings are Old College and the Kydd Building, within the Bell Street complex. The main train and bus station is a five minute walk from campus. A gym, several eateries, the library and multiple social spaces are contained within the campus. Students can join sports clubs or pursue their interests in student-run societies such as football, dance or even tabletop games.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Abertay University is a compact, friendly, and innovative institution located in the heart of Dundee, Scotland. Originally founded in 1888 as the Dundee Technical Institute, it has evolved into a global leader in tech-driven education.

The university is world-renowned for being the first to offer a degree in computer games and is a National Centre for Excellence in both Computer Games Education and Cybersecurity. Academic life is structured across two main faculties: the Faculty of Design, Informatics and Business and the Faculty of Social and Applied Sciences.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Abertay offers a range of housing options to help you feel at home. You can choose from University Halls, which are integrated into the student community, or various private accommodation options located within walking distance of the campus.

Popular student residences near the university include Marketgait Apartments, Keiller Court, and Parker House. These residences often offer ensuite rooms, studios, and shared apartments, with many featuring amenities like gyms, cinema rooms, and study areas.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus,
feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Lab
highlights.value: Abertay boasts world-class specialist labs, including one of Europe’s largest PlayStation 5 teaching labs. Other notable facilities include the Competitive Games Lab, Wacom Cintiq Lab, a Hacking Laboratory, and a specialist consumer research lab for food science.

highlights.title: Library
highlights.value: The Bernard King Library is the heart of the campus, providing extensive digital and physical resources, quiet study zones, and collaborative learning spaces. It also houses a dedicated Library Café for quick breaks between study sessions.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value:
When you study at Abertay, you join a close-knit community where you are a name, not a number. With around 4,000 students, the campus offers a personal experience where it is easy to make friends and get to know your lecturers.

The Abertay Students' Association supports over 20 student-led societies, ranging from football and dance to tabletop gaming and Formula 1. Additionally, the Sports Union hosts various clubs that compete in national BUCS competitions, ensuring there is always a way for you to stay active and connected.

highlights.title: Cafeteria
highlights.value: On-campus dining is centred around the Student Centre, which houses the Aroma Cafe. It is a popular spot for you to grab light snacks, drinks, or hot meals.

highlights.title: Sports
highlights.value: You’ll have access to various sports clubs and training facilities. The university has a strong sporting culture, with the Sports Union managing everything from competitive teams to recreational fitness activities.

highlights.title: Employability
highlights.value:
Abertay is highly focused on making you work-ready. All undergraduate degrees are designed in partnership with industry experts and include built-in experience such as work placements, industry mentoring, or real-world projects.

The university’s career services provide guidance on CV building and interview preparation, while the cyberQuarter and Emergent Technology Centre offer opportunities to engage with innovative research and business sectors.
